project.project_title: Draft and Send Demand Letter via Certified Mail and Email

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001],

I hope you’re doing well. Below is a concise overview.

In August 2023, Edwin Mason and John O’Brien signed a Secured Promissory Note for $1.23M, making themselves personally liable as borrowers. They also signed a Pledge & Security Agreement pledging their ownership interests in Meade Transportation, Inc. (MTI) and Virginia Freight Holdings, LLC (VFH). The Note had a 30% interest rate and matured after 90 days. Their failure to repay caused a default in November 2023 and activated the 35% default interest rate.

As of October 1, 2025, approximately $2.5M remains due, and default interest continues to accrue at more than $1,100 each day. Although repeated demands have been made, they have neither paid nor proposed an acceptable repayment plan. Instead, they have tried to introduce “updated loan agreements” that would diminish my secured position and eliminate their personal liability.

My request is straightforward:

Draft and issue a formal demand letter on your letterhead to Edwin Mason and John O’Brien that cites their duties under the Note and Security Agreement.

Mail the letter through U.S. Certified Mail so formal delivery is documented.

Afterward, email both Edwin and John with the demand letter attached, advise them of the certified mailing, and copy me.

To streamline the work, I have attached:

A chronology summary and balance calculation

A proposed demand letter for you to revise

A copy of the Secured Promissory Note

A copy of the Pledge & Security Agreement

I would like this finished within the next week. Because most of the drafting has already been completed, I would prefer a reasonable flat fee. My main objective is to have the demand formally issued on your letterhead so the record is established.

Please tell me when you are available to speak so we can agree on the flat fee.

value_updates.purpose: formally demand payment and establish a record of the borrowers' default and obligations

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001] —

I’m prepared to move ahead for $625 provided that the following is included:

Send two certified USPS letters (I’ll supply both addresses), then email one related confirmation to the two involved parties once the letters have been mailed.

Manage as many as three email exchanges with the other party after they reply. I’ll prepare the responses, and you can transmit them for me.

Have the entire matter completed by Monday.

Please confirm whether that arrangement works.

Thanks,
[FREELANCER_NAME_002]

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001],

Attached is the draft Final Demand and Notice of Default for you to examine before I sign it. The draft incorporates every term from the Note and Pledge & Security Agreement and describes the available enforcement measures, including foreclosure, arbitration, possible damages, and language concerning credit impact.

Kindly review it and send me any edits or feedback before I execute and release the final document.

For your reference, the Note lists these official notice details:
• Stratagem Global Corporation / Edward Mason / John O’Brien
1717 K Street NW, Washington DC 20006
[EMAIL_001]

Best,
[FREELANCER_NAME_001]

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports preparing a draft Final Demand and Notice of Default that reflects the Note and Pledge & Security Agreement and outlines proposed enforcement steps for client review.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
After our recent discussion, I examined the executed agreements. Stratagem Global Corporation is the signatory to both the Note and Security Agreement; Mason and O’Brien executed them solely in their capacities as officers rather than personally.

Nevertheless, I recommend leaving the demand letter unchanged. Naming them personally maintains strong leverage without alerting them to this issue. Should they later dispute liability, fraud or alter-ego theories based on their behavior may still be pursued.

Also, yes, your email was in my spam folder—thank you for directing me there!

Best,
[FREELANCER_NAME_001]

ambiguity.description: The signed agreements appear to show Mason and O’Brien signing only as corporate officers, conflicting with the client's stated personal-liability premise and requiring a decision on whether the demand should continue addressing them personally.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Hello!

As reflected in the tracking, one package was delivered, but the second was returned to me. It arrived back this morning, which is why my reply was delayed.

As part of additional follow-up yesterday, I contacted the delivery service and asked them to check every suite number in the building. They responded that they could not locate any person or organization under that name. Accordingly, I will mail another copy bearing today’s date to the official corporate address.

There has also been no reply to my earlier email. After the replacement mailing is sent to and received at the company’s official address, delivery will be considered official for all purposes. At that stage, we can evaluate the options available to you.

execution.observed_behavior: Of the two certified-mail packages, one was received but the other was returned after the delivery service could not locate the named recipient or entity.
